case_name: Sumit Raina vs Ut Of J&K And Others

parties.respondent_defendant: Ut Of J&K and others, wife (Respondent No. 5) and Police Station, Women Cell, Jammu (Respondent No. 4)

facts_of_case: Matrimonial dispute between petitioner and his wife regarding which proceedings under Section 13 of Hindu Marriage Act and Section 125 Cr. P.C. are pending before the Family Court, Jammu.

legal_principles.principle: Negotiations between parties should not be stretched too far to give it a colour of harassment.
legal_principles.held: It is not open to respondent No. 4 to stretch the negotiations between the petitioner and respondent No. 5 too far so as to give it a colour of harassment to any of the parties.

legal_principles.principle: A party cannot unilaterally decide the fate of a marriage.
legal_principles.held: At this stage there are hardly any chances of settlement between the petitioner and respondent No. 5, because the petitioner has already filed a petition under Section 13 of Hindu Marriage Act against his wife.

outcome.final_order: Respondent No. 4 not to harass petitioner by calling him unnecessarily to Police Station.

use_for_drafting: representing clients in Family Court proceedings
